description: I am Prabhat Gautam, Founder & Project Lead at BhimaX Innovations, developing ARASS (Atmospheric Regeneration and AQI Stabilization System). ARASS integrates NASA Earth observation, satellite remote sensing, AI-driven analysis, atmospheric monitoring, advanced filtration, fluid dynamics and energy recovery. Seeking passionate researchers, engineers and developers in Earth Science, AI/ML, data analytics, software and mechanical engineering to build innovative environmental solutions.(change Envt)
